Requirement Summary: Ten functional modules, four distinct roles (Employee, Grievance Staff, Department Head, Grievance Admin) governed by RBAC.

Password complexity (>=8 chars, upper, lower, digit, symbol), lockout after 5 failures in 15m window, 15m lockout duration, auto-unlock, 30m inactivity session timeout, password reset invalidates all sessions.
Server-side authorization checks, role-based resource permissions, data access restrictions, session management, prevention of deactivated user access.

Structured submission form, mandatory title (>=5 chars, non-numeric), description (>=20 chars, non-numeric), active category/subcategory validation, unique reference number (GRS-YYYY-XXXX), idempotency key deduplication, case tracking hub and chronological timeline.

Investigation findings and corrective actions, non-numeric validation, additional information requests, 7-day employee response period, reminder notifications, auto-closure with reason INFORMATION_NOT_PROVIDED upon non-response.

Resolution preparation (>=20 chars), employee review, acceptance rating (1-5), rejection requires mandatory reason (>=10 chars), rework cycle moves case to REWORK and increments shared attempt counter, 7-day auto-closure with RESOLVED_INACTIVITY upon employee confirmation non-response.

Reopening allowed within 14 calendar days from closure date/time, shared attempt counter enforces maximum 3 combined successful attempts (rework + reopen), 4th attempt strictly rejected without manual review, fresh SLA cycle initialized with same priority default duration.
Feedback available after grievance closure, star rating 1-5 mandatory, comments optional, feedback submission does NOT alter CLOSED status or reopen case.

Single Primary Department coordinates final resolution, Supporting Departments submit findings, parallel and sequential execution modes, department notes privacy isolation, reminder notifications for non-response, conflict resolution flow.

Continuous 24x7 calendar hours operating through weekends and holidays from submission, baseline priority durations (Critical 24h, High 48h, Medium 72h, Low 120h), 50% warning to Staff only, 75% Level 1 escalation to Staff & Primary Head, 100% Level 2 breach with automatic ownership takeover by Primary Head and Admin compliance notification only, operational indicators do NOT alter lifecycle status.
User management and deactivated user handling, department CRUD and inactive department routing exclusion, category/subcategory taxonomy, routing rules with circular dependency prevention.

Department Head assignment queue, 100-point smart staff recommendation algorithm (Skills 35, Exp 25, Workload 20, Avail 10, SLA 10), caseload capacity limit of 12 active grievances, staff deactivation reassignment workflow.

10 MB individual file size constraint, max 5 attachments across lifecycle, allowed formats (PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG, PNG, XLS, XLSX), executable/script blacklist, MIME type verification, immutability of submitted evidence.
In-app notification interface, event-driven alerts (submission, assignment, clarification, SLA milestones, rework, reopening), unread badge counter, deep linking, 24h action reminders.
Automatic recording of significant events, transactional consistency (audit failure rolls back business transaction), immutable records, actor attribution, before/after diffs, credential redaction.

Eligible only when IN_PROGRESS and unbreached, Department Head sole approval authority, max 1 request per cycle, max 2 approved extensions across lifecycle, extension cap = stricter of 24h and 25% baseline SLA, cumulative cap <= 25% baseline SLA.

Operational volume metrics, Turnaround Time (TAT) analytics (average and median, pending cases excluded), automated rule-based recurrence clustering (Category Clustering >7 in 30d, Location Hotspot >=3 in 30d, Duplicate Cluster >=2 active) generating open RecurringGrievanceAlert.
Asynchronous streamed export to CSV and Excel, role-based filtering, CSV formula injection sanitization escaping (=, +, -, @) with leading quote.

Draft article generation from resolved cases, duplicate similarity checking (>90% likely duplicate, 75-89% similar), Department Head review and publishing, non-numeric rejection validation, similar article recommendations.
